description: Free, private, offline voice-to-text for Windows. 100% local (Parakeet/Whisper, no API key) or OpenAI cloud. Hold Ctrl+Alt, speak, release — cleaned text pastes at the cursor.
notes: On first launch a wizard sets up Local mode (no key, runs on your PC) or Cloud (your OpenAI key). Local downloads a model once.
Usage: hold Ctrl+Alt and talk. Docs: https://github.com/apgodlike/voiceflow
